description:
Elixir rejects a literal string bitstring field with size(...), including <<"ab"::size(2)>> and <<"ab"::binary-size(2)>>: literal strings accept only endianness and a compatible type specifier. fz quoted-source decoding accepts the size and sized_for_binary_literal deliberately preserves it, leaving an integer-typed/binary-valued mismatch or a surprising binary size interpretation downstream.

Add diagnostic fixtures for expression and pattern positions, point at the modifier span, and validate this at the quoted-source field boundary before semantic/backend construction. This is separate from fz-5xp.101, which supplies the missing implicit binary spec for a valid unsuffixed literal.
title: [BUG] Bitstring literal strings accept unsupported size modifiers
